description:
## Functional specifications and files
Implement composable ensure-and-edit prerequisite for canonical source references. Resolve trusted record through existing provider boundary, authorize before mutation, reuse document identity/permissions, transactionally save identity and labels only on Save. No conversion/chunks/embedding. Cover concurrent ingestion and source lifecycle.
Files/owners: Ingestion source identity/document permission owner, focused validated Action only if audit proves missing; Ingestion API/Event builder and existing source tests.
## Tests to add before implementation
Extend source/document/editor boundary tests for unauthorized/nil actors, idempotency, concurrent first ingestion, canonical provider/config collisions, rollback/cancel, source-derived permission projection, tombstones and no model config.
## Branches/paths validated
Success, invalid input, nil/denied actor, stale/concurrent write, unavailable/deleted source, lifecycle cleanup and failure rollback where relevant. No hidden cross-service calls.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo, validated Actions, NodeRouter and domain boundaries. Mock only external provider/conversion HTTP when relevant; runtime dependencies via existing Zaq.Config opts, no global mutation.
## Documentation
Update owner module docs and relevant existing service/BO guide alongside behavior; durable evidence here. Follow docs/documentation.md.
## Action reuse assessment
New focused prerequisite operation if no existing one fits, backed by Document.insert_new, ExternalSource and ExternalPermissions; trusted canonical source+actor+typed edits/versions -> identity/projection or typed errors. BO consumes via NodeRouter only. Audit must fix exact ownership before implementation.
## Validation/dependencies
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Scoped tests + mix q only per implementation issue. Final precommit reserved for final child. Supervisor verifies before closure. New feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.15 -> zaq-kw0.16.

comments.text: Approved public contract: reuse existing resource_editor/edit_resource Events and EditResourceLabels Action with selector %{type: "source", source_ref: %{provider, config_id, record_id}}. Source open resolves canonical Channels context with read authority and returns typed projection, canonical selector, document_id nil|id and source_kind without persistence. Save freshly resolves update-authorized context, rejects deleted/mismatched/folder targets until .4, and atomically insert_new canonical Document, lock row, apply shared checked source ACL, then reuse versioned document assignment editor. No content conversion/jobs/model, no authorization marker, no separate tree. Evaluate explicit current-super-admin event permission opt-in only from verified BOActor; never trust actor bypass or infer update from read. Read-only design prepared while .11 fixture approval is pending. Sourcecontext ae69cee2 integrated as ac24cd73c; q and 284 focused integration tests pass.

Reuse/ownership evidence: Labels facade extends existing resource_editor and edit_resource selectors for canonical source_ref; same EditResourceLabels Action/Events, no new Action/tool. SourceLabels owns read/update source-context orchestration and outer identity+ACL+assignment transaction; ResourceLabels remains typed projection/CAS owner with server-only resolved-context opt (facade drops it for ordinary selectors). Channels owns source identity/permissions; current RecordSource materialization+source_override and provider browser both use ExternalSource.source, including Disk UUID/config. No supported alias maps historical local-path Documents; canonical row reused and unrelated local rows preserved. State: open/Cancel read-only; Save insert_new source conflict idempotent, document lock then checked ExternalPermissions.apply then shared edit; no conversion/chunk/jobs/model side effects. Actor bypass stripped and derived from current verified BOrole only. Source context remains internal for .4 nearest-folder resolver. Document.insert_new validation crash proven and fixed narrowly; real parallel unboxed insert_new/upsert test proves same ID+materialized content under race, cleans unique own row. Existing source suite extended through real Api/Action/Channels/context/provider-stub/Repo for nativefalse, ACL and value rollback, stale CAS, current permissions/role, namespace isolation, real Disk canonical reuse and content preservation. Lifecycle deliberately retains unwatched Document+assignments per existing owner; fresh source selector denies tombstone, actual watched deletion FK-cascades labels (no marker/new deletion criterion). Initial source+Document132checks pass; final checks and independent review pending.
